Climate change.evidence: Present-day climate change includes both global warming—the ongoing increase in global average temperature—and its wider effects on Earth's climate system.
The modern-day rise in global temperatures is driven by human activities, especially fossil fuel (coal, oil and natural gas) burning since the Industrial Revolution.
